youtube.title: Bhishma ne mrityu ka samay kaise chuna? 🏹 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Raja Shantanu ke putra Devavrat ne apne pita ki khushi ke liye Satyavati ke pita ke saamne bhayankar pratigya li ki wo kabhi raja nahi banenge aur aajeevan brahmachari rahenge. Is kathin pratigya ke kaaran devta aakash se phool barsane lage aur unka naam Bhishma pad gaya.

Pita Shantanu is tyag se prasann hue aur unhe icchha mrityu ka vardaan diya, yani wo apni marzi se mrityu ka samay chun sakte the. Kurukshetra ke yuddh mein baanon ki shaiya par lete hue Bhishma ne Surya ke uttarayan hone tak pratiksha ki aur tabhi pran tyage.

Katha ka strot: Mahabharata, Adi Parva (adhyay 94) aur Bhishma Parva.
